town_intro_sharps_lines_0.text: Lil Blunt. Come in off the street. Mind the glass. This is what the river wants.
town_intro_sharps_lines_0.speaker: rich

town_intro_sharps_lines_1.text: A Sharps, Model 1874. The buffalo hunters called her the Buffalo Gun.
town_intro_sharps_lines_1.speaker: rich

town_intro_sharps_lines_3.text: Thirty-inch octagon barrel, double set triggers, a tang sight you can read at six hundred yards.
town_intro_sharps_lines_3.speaker: rich

town_intro_sharps_lines_4.text: Set the back trigger and the front one breaks at a whisper. Take a look. Don't take her home yet.
town_intro_sharps_lines_4.speaker: rich

town_intro_sharps_lines_5.text: three coin and she is yours, cartridges by the box. Coin, never credit.
town_intro_sharps_lines_5.speaker: rich

town_intro_gatling_after_1.text: She stays on the post, Lil Blunt. When the river comes you will want her near the bank.
town_intro_gatling_after_1.speaker: rich

town_trade_00.text: You found the lane. Most don't.
town_trade_00.speaker: rich

town_trade_01.text: Rich? Inferno said you know this town.
town_trade_01.speaker: lil_blunt

town_trade_02.text: Iron's on the wall. Coin's the only tongue I take.
town_trade_02.speaker: rich

town_trade_04.text: Set trigger. It reaches clean across the water.
town_trade_04.speaker: rich

town_trade_06.text: Lead's sold by the box. It never comes cheap and it never comes free.
town_trade_06.speaker: rich

town_trade_08.text: That don't spend here. Bring the coin you earned.
town_trade_08.speaker: rich

town_trade_10.text: Mind the lane on the way out.
town_trade_10.speaker: rich

town_trade_12.text: And bring it back empty. That's how I know it worked.
town_trade_12.speaker: rich

town_trade_13.text: I'll take a look. Let's hear what you've got.
town_trade_13.speaker: lil_blunt

town_trade_14.text: Much obliged. I'll make it count.
town_trade_14.speaker: lil_blunt

town_greet_clerk_0.text: Morning, traveler. Keep your papers dry.
town_greet_clerk_0.speaker: clerk

town_greet_clerk_1.text: Claim office is down the boardwalk, partner.
town_greet_clerk_1.speaker: clerk

town_greet_oldtimer_0.text: Take it easy. This town ain't going anywhere.
town_greet_oldtimer_0.speaker: oldtimer

town_greet_oldtimer_1.text: Mind the dust. It gets into everything.
town_greet_oldtimer_1.speaker: oldtimer

town_greet_rancher_0.text: Fine day to be on your feet, partner.
town_greet_rancher_0.speaker: rancher

town_greet_rancher_1.text: Watch the horses round the bend.
town_greet_rancher_1.speaker: rancher

town_greet_dressmaker_0.text: Morning. Mind that loose stitch on your sleeve.
town_greet_dressmaker_0.speaker: dressmaker

town_greet_dressmaker_1.text: A little dust never hurt good cloth.
town_greet_dressmaker_1.speaker: dressmaker

town_greet_lady_0.text: Well now, a new face. Welcome to town.
town_greet_lady_0.speaker: lady

town_greet_lady_1.text: Best keep an ear out round the saloon.
town_greet_lady_1.speaker: lady

town_greet_bald_worker_0.text: Good day. Plenty of work before sundown.
town_greet_bald_worker_0.speaker: bald_worker

town_greet_bald_worker_1.text: Boardwalk's solid. Boots'll last longer on it.
town_greet_bald_worker_1.speaker: bald_worker

town_greet_grandma_0.text: There you are, dear. Stay out of trouble.
town_greet_grandma_0.speaker: grandma

town_greet_grandfather_0.text: Easy does it, son. No need to hurry.
town_greet_grandfather_0.speaker: grandfather

town_greet_grandfather_1.text: Good weather. Best enjoy it while it lasts.
town_greet_grandfather_1.speaker: grandfather

town_greet_grandmother_0.text: Lovely to see somebody new about town.
town_greet_grandmother_0.speaker: grandmother

town_greet_grandmother_1.text: Rest those feet when you get the chance.
town_greet_grandmother_1.speaker: grandmother

town_greet_youth_1.text: Stay sharp round here. Folks notice things.
town_greet_youth_1.speaker: youth

town_greet_boy_0.text: Hi there! Want to see how high I can jump?
town_greet_boy_0.speaker: boy

town_greet_boy_1.text: Watch me! I almost made it that time.
town_greet_boy_1.speaker: boy

town_greet_braided_girl_1.text: Bet you can't skip as quick as me.
town_greet_braided_girl_1.speaker: braided_girl

town_greet_bob_girl_1.text: Just one more turn, then it's your go.
town_greet_bob_girl_1.speaker: bob_girl

town_boardwalk.prompt: One pair of leather boot footsteps on an old timber boardwalk, natural short wooden taps with a slight plank creak. Close dry realistic foley, no voice, no wind, no bell, no music.

town_intro_sharps_lines_2.text: Falling block. One shot, then you earn the next one.
town_intro_sharps_lines_2.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_call_0.text: Now the one that is not for sale. Follow me out front.
town_intro_gatling_call_0.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_lines_0.text: Colt Gatling Gun. Six barrels, a drum on top, a crank on the side.
town_intro_gatling_lines_0.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_lines_1.text: Doctor Gatling's patent, built by Colt. Turn the crank and the barrels turn with it. Watch the plates.
town_intro_gatling_lines_1.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_after_0.text: Bolted to the porch. Not for coin, not for gold. Rich will not sell her and I will not let him.
town_intro_gatling_after_0.speaker: utah

town_intro_gatling_after_2.text: Go on. Take the crank. Short bursts. The drum is all there is.
town_intro_gatling_after_2.speaker: utah

town_intro_closing_0.text: Steady hands. Remember her when the shipment comes down.
town_intro_closing_0.speaker: utah

town_trade_03.text: River rises tomorrow. Something rides it down.
town_trade_03.speaker: utah

town_trade_05.text: From the high rocks you'll see the whole bend. Take the high rocks.
town_trade_05.speaker: utah

town_trade_07.text: Skiff's sound, crates are sealed. She'll ride wet and ride heavy.
town_trade_07.speaker: utah

town_trade_09.text: Come back when the purse sits heavier.
town_trade_09.speaker: utah

town_trade_11.text: Be on the overlook by first light. I'll be at the water.
town_trade_11.speaker: utah

vo_sheriff_1.text: Well now. Somebody rode in on Inferno's quad and lived. What can I do for you, partner?
vo_sheriff_1.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_2.text: Certificates are the Minister's department. Minister Mike Dean, this young fella wants one.
vo_sheriff_2.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_3.text: Till then, wet your whistle at the saloon across the street. And mind who's watching when you pay.
vo_sheriff_3.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_witness.text: Hold it. If this is happening, it happens proper. I'm the little fella's witness. Square up. Listen for the town bell. Nobody draws till that bell rings.
vo_sheriff_witness.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_foul.text: I said wait for the bell. Again.
vo_sheriff_foul.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_win.text: That settles it. The map's yours, son. Fair and square, and I saw it.
vo_sheriff_win.speaker: sheriff

vo_sheriff_lose.text: Too slow. On your feet. Listen for the bell, and we'll do it again.
vo_sheriff_lose.speaker: sheriff

town_jail_00.text: Here he is. Caught him holding the gate open for the bears.
town_jail_00.speaker: sheriff

town_jail_01.text: All I did was open a gate. Somebody paid me to bring them in.
town_jail_01.speaker: prisoner

town_jail_03.text: Never saw a face. Coin, and an order: soften the claims before the vault locks.
town_jail_03.speaker: prisoner

town_jail_04.text: They want Fort Knox first. Watch the lake outflow, the river... the trains.
town_jail_04.speaker: prisoner

town_jail_05.text: Find who brought the bears, Lil Blunt. I'll keep this one where he is.
town_jail_05.speaker: sheriff

town_job_04.text: Rich and Utah. I'm on it, Sheriff.
town_job_04.speaker: lil_blunt

town_bullback_00.text: Heard that Gatling clear across town. Figured it had to be you, little man.
town_bullback_00.speaker: inferno

town_bullback_01.text: Come on. First whiskey's on me.
town_bullback_01.speaker: inferno

town_body_02.text: So who put a hole in his head?
town_body_02.speaker: inferno

town_body_03.text: Must've been a bird that had to get rid of the heavy load.
town_body_03.speaker: lil_blunt

town_drinks_01.text: To the quickest little hand in GoldMine.
town_drinks_01.speaker: inferno

town_drinks_03.text: Listen, my cousin Flux needs a hand with his new kettle.
town_drinks_03.speaker: inferno

town_drinks_04.text: We'll lie low a little while and meet up later. Stay out of trouble.
town_drinks_04.speaker: inferno

stamp_thud.prompt: An old brass and wood office stamp pressed firmly once onto a paper certificate on a wooden counter: a solid thump with a faint wooden knock. Close, realistic, no voices, no music.

gun_pickup.prompt: A heavy steel single-action revolver is picked up off a dusty dirt street and a folded paper map is tucked into a leather coat: metal scrape, leather creak, paper rustle. Close realistic foley, no voices, no music.

whiskey_gulp.prompt: A man lifts a heavy glass of whiskey, takes one long satisfying swallow and sets the glass back down on a wooden bar with a soft knock and a relaxed breath. Close realistic foley, no words, no music.

trail_lb_start.text: Logan's Lake first. Dude's horse needs water in this heat.
trail_lb_start.speaker: lil_blunt

trail_lb_ambush.text: Hammer's men on the ridge! Keep moving.
trail_lb_ambush.speaker: lil_blunt

trail_lb_unhorse.text: The horse is down. I will finish it on foot.
trail_lb_unhorse.speaker: lil_blunt

trail_lb_lake.text: Logan's Lake. Easy now. Drink, then I go see Logan.
trail_lb_lake.speaker: lil_blunt

jh_bandit_1.text: That is the rider! Get him off that horse!
jh_bandit_1.speaker: bandit

jh_bandit_2.text: Hammer's coin says he never reaches the auction!
jh_bandit_2.speaker: bandit

jh_bandit_3.text: Shoot the horse if you cannot hit the man!
jh_bandit_3.speaker: bandit

dude_ranch_07.text: Name's Lil Blunt. Minister Mike Dean told me to get a horse here.
dude_ranch_07.speaker: lil_blunt

dude_ranch_09.text: Two BTC? That's a steep climb for a ride, Dude.
dude_ranch_09.speaker: lil_blunt

town_cell_00.text: Name's Bam. Bam Bankman Free. The last part is doing a lot of work.
town_cell_00.speaker: bam

town_cell_01.text: Easy, Bam. Lil Blunt. You look like you've had a year.
town_cell_01.speaker: lil_blunt

town_cell_02.text: Let's just say the books didn't balance. I'd sooner leave it there.
town_cell_02.speaker: bam

town_cell_03.text: That's enough for me. No man owes me his worst day.
town_cell_03.speaker: lil_blunt

town_cell_04.text: I used to call every dip an opportunity. Then the floor learned my name.
town_cell_04.speaker: bam

town_cell_05.text: Floor's an honest teacher. Still, a man can get back up.
town_cell_05.speaker: lil_blunt

town_cell_06.text: I told folks I was building a future. Turned out I was renting their patience.
town_cell_06.speaker: bam

town_cell_07.text: Well. You can sit quiet with me. That's a fair trade.
town_cell_07.speaker: lil_blunt

town_cell_08.text: You're kind, little man. Next coin I earn, I'm counting it twice.
town_cell_08.speaker: bam

town_cell_09.text: Count it slow, Bam. And walk softer than you talk.
town_cell_09.speaker: lil_blunt

town_cold_clerk.text: Papers are in order. Your manners are another matter.
town_cold_clerk.speaker: clerk

town_cold_oldtimer.text: I've seen quicker tempers than yours end in the same cell.
town_cold_oldtimer.speaker: oldtimer

town_cold_rancher.text: Keep your barrel off my horses and your distance from me.
town_cold_rancher.speaker: rancher

town_cold_grandma.text: You sit with your thoughts, dear. I'll keep my welcome for later.
town_cold_grandma.speaker: grandma

town_cold_youth.text: That was your one warning shot with us. Don't ask for another.
town_cold_youth.speaker: youth

town_loot_00.text: A Colt Peacemaker. And the map to the auction - that's what he wanted a Bitcoin for.
town_loot_00.speaker: lil_blunt

town_gift_00.text: Oh - and take this to Mike Dean for me. The Gold Panner. He's had his eye on it for years.
town_gift_00.speaker: inferno

town_gift_01.text: The Gold Panner. I'll see he gets it.
town_gift_01.speaker: lil_blunt

town_minister2_00.text: Minister. Inferno sent you this. The Gold Panner.
town_minister2_00.speaker: lil_blunt

town_panic_00.text: Lord have mercy! What in heaven's name happened out here?
town_panic_00.speaker: minister

town_panic_02.text: Then somebody had better pray for that poor soul. I'll see to him.
town_panic_02.speaker: minister

town_body_01.text: Evening, Inferno. Just saying a few words for him.
town_body_01.speaker: minister

dude_ranch_02.text: These are my horses. I sell to folks with business; the Minister knows me.
dude_ranch_02.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_03.text: Long road, huh? Here, one of Dude's Chill Buds, grown right here on the ranch. A gift for the trail. Stay chill.
dude_ranch_03.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_04.text: Anything else? Two Chill Buds for one BTC, partner. Good little road companions.
dude_ranch_04.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_05.text: Pleasure. Two fresh Chill Buds, tucked safe in your tabs. Enjoy the easy road.
dude_ranch_05.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_06.text: No worries. Come back when your purse is heavier; the buds keep, and so does the welcome.
dude_ranch_06.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_08.text: Mike Dean sent you? Then you're good folk. A saddled horse is two BTC.
dude_ranch_08.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_10.text: Fair haggle. Two even, no fooling. That's the friend price, and she's worth it.
dude_ranch_10.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_11.text: Deal. Two BTC, square and easy. She's yours, partner. Treat her gentle.
dude_ranch_11.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_12.text: Short on coin? Take her on credit until the auction. Two BTC later. Mike's people are good for it.
dude_ranch_12.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_13.text: First go to Logan's Lake so your horse can drink and cool down in this heat. It's on the map.
dude_ranch_13.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_14.text: Anything else, partner? Your horse is ready when you are. No hurry around here.
dude_ranch_14.speaker: dude

dude_ranch_15.text: Remember: Logan's Lake first. Let her drink and cool down. It's right there on the map.
dude_ranch_15.speaker: dude

town_cold_mike_dean_0.text: I'll pray for the man you hurt, and for the temper that did it.
town_cold_mike_dean_0.speaker: minister

town_cold_mike_dean_1.text: Kindness costs nothing, son. Try spending a little more of it.
town_cold_mike_dean_1.speaker: minister

town_minister2_01.text: The Gold Panner! Bless that big fella, he remembered.
town_minister2_01.speaker: minister

town_minister2_02.text: And your certificate, son. Made out in your name - stamped and sealed.
town_minister2_02.speaker: minister

town_minister2_04.text: You'll want a horse for the trail. Go see my friend Dude at the horse stables. Tell him I sent you.
town_minister2_04.speaker: minister

town_panic_01.text: A fair draw, Minister. The stranger called it. The little fella was faster.
town_panic_01.speaker: sheriff

town_job_00.text: That was some fine shooting, son. Haven't seen a draw that clean in years.
town_job_00.speaker: sheriff

town_job_01.text: I could use a hand like yours. Somebody let the bears hold Fort Knox.
town_job_01.speaker: sheriff

town_job_02.text: Find out who. My prisoner in the jailhouse knows more than he's telling.
town_job_02.speaker: sheriff

town_job_03.text: But get yourself properly armed first. Go see Rich and Utah, down the side lane.
town_job_03.speaker: sheriff

town_law_arrest.text: Drop it, Blunt. You just shot a man in my town.
town_law_arrest.speaker: sheriff

town_law_release.text: Your irons stay with me while you're in my town. Take your pick and walk soft.
town_law_release.speaker: sheriff

town_law_fine.text: That damage comes out of your purse, Blunt. BTC, on the barrelhead.
town_law_fine.speaker: sheriff

town_cold_sheriff_0.text: Walk soft, Blunt. My town remembers.
town_cold_sheriff_0.speaker: sheriff

town_cold_sheriff_1.text: You're still welcome at my office. The easy trust has to be earned back.
town_cold_sheriff_1.speaker: sheriff

town_jobjail_00.text: Come on. I'll walk you over, and you can hear it from him yourself.
town_jobjail_00.speaker: sheriff

vo_minister_1.text: Welcome, friend. A certificate is made out in your name, and it stays in your name. It cannot be sold on and it cannot be traded. Bring your share and I will stamp it.
vo_minister_1.speaker: minister

vo_opp_2.text: Give me a Bitcoin in exchange for this map to the auction. You could walk away with more gold and Bitcoin.
vo_opp_2.speaker: stranger

logan_lb_depth.text: So the lake holds the depth, and the river carries what is ready?
logan_lb_depth.speaker: lil_blunt

logan_depth.text: This depth stays deep. We stage what comes in before anything goes downstream.
logan_depth.speaker: logan

logan_cargo.text: Exactly. Check the cargo at that staging marker. Keep the bank secure; don't empty the lake.
logan_cargo.speaker: logan

logan_handoff.text: Cargo checked. The depth holds. Follow the outflow to the high ground—the day-88 shipment leaves from here.
logan_handoff.speaker: logan
